degree_rationale: First Man's prayer in distress and the help sent in answer — Mother of Life prayed for him, Living Spirit was sent, Ambassador chose forth, Jesus completed the threefold purpose; the soul redeemed forth, set on her feet in rest and joy. Treats the natural completed sequence of prayer-and-answer reaching all the way down.
direction_rationale: The settled prayer-and-answer cycle reaching the soul: prayer rises, help descends, soul placed in rest. Completion of the salvific cycle as it touches the natural human.
grand_man_function: Natural prayer-and-answer seal — the completed cycle of salvific intercession reaching man.
title: The First Man's prayer in distress and the help sent in answer
